assumptions: exact arithmetic in Q(r) modulo the minimal polynomial of r

meta.falsification: Two stable configurations with the same integer value; a merged sum that stabilises to something other than rep(a+b).
meta.hypothesis: H-C02-4: for every terminating carry rule (sum b < m), distinct stable configurations of length <= L have distinct values, so each integer has exactly one stable representation. H-C02-5: stab(rep(a) + rep(b)) = rep(a + b).
meta.methodology: Enumerate every stable configuration up to L levels, reduce sum c_k x^k modulo the minimal polynomial of r, keep those whose value is an integer, group by value. Addition: 2000 random pairs per rule.
meta.question: In a terminating carry system, can an integer have a stable representation other than the normal form of its unary numeral? Does merging two normal forms and stabilising add them?
meta.title: Uniqueness of stable representations in emergent bases; addition by merging
